translations.web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
translations.bsb: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
translations.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
